_register: Buttons, menu entries and headings use the imperative 2nd person singular as Polish software does (Zapisz, Wypożycz, Zeskanuj kod kreskowy) or a noun (Wypożyczenia, Zwrot); sentences to the reader are impersonal or use the polite infinitive/impersonal -no/-to forms ("Nie znaleziono egzemplarza", "Należy wybrać klasę"), never ty-forms like "Możesz" and never "Pan/Pani"; no jokes, no exclamation marks.
_quotes: Polish low-high quotes „text” (U+201E opening, U+201D closing, e.g. Wypożyczono: „{{title}}”), nested quotes ‚text’ or «text»; no space before : ; ? !; decimal comma, dates as 31.12.2026; single-letter words (i, o, u, w, z, a) should not end a line, so use a non-breaking space after them in running text; the arrow → stays.
_plural: Polish has the forms one, few, many, other (1 uczeń; 2-4, 22-24 uczniowie; 5-21, 25-31 uczniów; 1,5 ucznia as other); give all four, e.g. {{count}} {{count:plural; one:egzemplarz; few:egzemplarze; many:egzemplarzy; other:egzemplarza;}}.

copy.note: One physical copy with its own barcode; never « kopia » (a photocopy or a backup).

record.note: Catalogue entry of a title, as in Polish library systems (MAK+, Koha PL, Prolib); « rekord » is the short form for menus and buttons where space is tight and is understood; keep one of the two per message type: « opis » on buttons, « opis bibliograficzny » in text.

patron.note: Usual word in Polish school and public libraries (« czytelnik », plural « czytelnicy »); not « użytkownik », which is the generic software word.

card.note: Short form « karta » where the context is clear; « karta czytelnika » is also used but the library-card wording is chosen.

loan.note: The verb is « wypożyczyć »; the circulation area is « Wypożyczenia ».

return.note: The action: « Zwrot » on the menu, « zwrócić » or « przyjąć zwrot » for the verb.

renew.note: The word Polish libraries use for extending the due date (verb « prolongować »); Koha PL says « odnowienie ». Keep « prolongata » everywhere.

overdue.note: The state of an item past its due date: adjective « przetrzymany » (przetrzymane wypożyczenie), « po terminie » in short labels and status badges.

reminder.note: The printed slip asking for the return; the technical library word, plural « monity ». « Upomnienie » is plainer but sounds like a disciplinary warning to children, so it is not used.

call number.note: The shelf mark on the spine (B 4 DEL, 590 ROS), as in Polish libraries.

spine band.note: The coloured band on the spine with a pictogram and the sygnatura; the sticker as a whole is « etykieta grzbietowa », but the band keeps the word « pasek ».

label.note: Adhesive label with a barcode: « etykieta z kodem kreskowym ».

barcode.note: Plural « kody kreskowe »; not « kod paskowy ».

class.note: A school class (3 B); in Polish schools the classes are numbered 1-8 in primary school.

group.note: Used for a group of teachers.

reading level.note: The school year a book is meant for; also understood « poziom trudności », which is not used.

classification.note: The sorting scheme (UKD / Dewey for non-fiction); Polish libraries use UKD, but the program's neutral word is « klasyfikacja ».

stocktaking.note: Checking the shelves against the catalogue; the Polish library term (the formal count is « skontrum zbiorów »). « Inwentaryzacja » is the accounting inventory and « inwentarz » the register of acquisitions, so neither is used here. Indeclinable in the singular: skontrum, skontra.

wish list.note: Books a patron would like the library to have; « zapotrzebowanie czytelników » is the formal term, « propozycje zakupu » is plainer and fits buttons. « Lista życzeń » is a shopping-site word and not used.

census.note: Registering the patrons with their photo; « spis czytelników ze zdjęciami » in full.

class upgrade.note: Moving every class up a year at the end of the school year; short form « promocja klas » is not used because « promocja » also means a student's pass to the next grade, which the library does not decide.

anonymise.note: Imperfective « anonimizować », noun « anonimizacja »; the action is irreversible, so the perfective is used on buttons.

staff account.note: A shared login per role; plural « konta pracowników ». Not « konto użytkownika », because « użytkownik » would clash with the patron.

backup.note: Plural « kopie zapasowe »; short form « kopia » only where the context is clear.

restore.note: Verb « przywrócić », button « Przywróć »; noun for a restore operation « przywrócenie ».

colour set.note: A palette of the interface; written « kolor » (not « barwa »).

print list.note: A list of patrons or copies to print cards or labels for; « lista do wydruku » where a preposition reads better.

scanner.note: The USB barcode reader that types like a keyboard; « skaner » is the colloquial form and is used for the short label and in running text once « czytnik kodów kreskowych » has been introduced. « Czytnik » alone is avoided because it is close to « czytelnik » (patron).

wizard.note: The first-start sequence of questions; « kreator konfiguracji » in full, as in Windows/Linux software.

demo data.note: The invented school the program can fill itself with.

student.note: Plural « uczniowie »; the feminine « uczennica » is not written alongside, the plain form is used for all.

teacher.note: Plural « nauczyciele »; feminine « nauczycielka » only where the gender is known.

administration.note: The settings area; « administracja » for the section, « administrator » for the person.

return desk / circulation desk.note: The desk where loans and returns are handled (« wypożyczalnia » is the room or department); the area as a whole is « Wypożyczenia ».
